message.content:
When you toss 3 fair coins, the number of heads you can obtain ranges from **0 to 3**.  
Here’s the breakdown:

| Number of Heads | Probability |
|-----------------|-------------|
| 0 heads         | \( \frac{1}{8} \) |
| 1 head          | \( \frac{3}{8} \) |
| 2 heads         | \( \frac{3}{8} \) |
| 3 heads         | \( \frac{1}{8} \) |

So you can get 0, 1, 2, or 3 heads.
